content: Additional action for InputOutputControl operations for ShortTermAdjustment with atomic S/R If the Dcm is processing an InputOutput- ControlByIdentifier request with inputOutputControlParameter equal to Short- TermAdjustment for a DID with configured atomic S/R interface, in addition to [SWS_Dcm_01275] the Dcm module shall update in the IOControlRequest_DID the data element controlState with content of the controlState from the request message.
